global_rules: Never concatenate sources and then randomly split rows.
Fit normalization on the registered training partition only.
Do not use target labels checkpoints or test metrics for selection.
Bind every emitted row to source dataset scenario map sequence and split IDs.

DeepMIMO.required_split: group by scenario before any receiver-level sampling
DeepMIMO.registered_candidate: asu_campus_3p5 and i1_2p5 are separate domains

UrbanMIMOMap.required_split: group by transmitter/configuration; never randomize individual rows
UrbanMIMOMap.scope_limit: one map only; no cross-map generalization claim

RadioMapSeer.required_split: hold out complete maps and keep derived Loc/ToA views joined
RadioMapSeer.scope_limit: RadioMap3DSeer is a public geometric substitute, not IRT2HighRes

DeepSense6G.required_split: group by seq_index; use Scenario 8 versus 33 only with shared modalities
DeepSense6G.scope_limit: hardware and 2D versus 3D LiDAR differences confound pure location claims
